scripts.test:bun: bun test --cwd skills/poteto-mode/scripts check-plan orch watch-pr
scripts.compatibility:check: node scripts/generate-compatibility-report.mjs --check && for d in compatibility/plugins/*/; do node scripts/generate-compatibility-report.mjs --check --lock "${d}upstream.lock.json" --map "${d}map.json" --output "${d}report.md" || exit 1; done
scripts.verify:offline: npm run test:offline && npm run test:bun && npm run typecheck && npm run compatibility:check
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:offline && npm run test:installed
